name: panel
description: High-tech network monitoring dashboard for UDM Pro Max, runs on Pi in kiosk mode.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta -k "npm run dev -w @panel/server" "npm run dev -w @panel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @panel/web && npm run build -w @panel/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @panel/server && npm run typecheck -w @panel/web
